goals: Map requirements to acceptance criteria and tests

requirements.statement: The feature must have a reviewable RFC before implementation.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The RFC includes background, expected outcome, acceptance criteria, and test case candidates.

risks: Overly broad RFCs can slow down small fixes.
